title: Stainless Steel Tip by DynaVap
description:
DynaVap’s Stainless Steel Tip is used on the “M” vaporizer but can be used on all vapcaps.
It has a different helical air intake design compared to the titanium tip and the use of stainless steel also produces a slightly different experience.
Included
1 x Stainless Steel Tip
